my-3D2dge handoff package

v0.76.0 · dev-build. Everything a coding agent needs to build, run, test and check a game on the full engine, as text files. Start with README.md, then read API.md. Play the template game.

  • README.mdstart here: what the package holds, which page to read, how to run and test a game
  • package.jsonpins Playwright for the tools
  • my-3d2dge.jsthe full engine, readable: the core and every module
  • my-3d2dge-agent.jsthe agent edition: the essential engine, its header a short manual
  • modules/arcade.jsa module, loaded after the engine: the coin-op's frame: scores, high-score tables and initials, lives, credits, turns, cards, the attract mode
  • modules/click.jsa module, loaded after the engine: point-and-click adventures: walk areas with holes, depth, hotspots, verbs, an inventory
  • modules/drive.jsa module, loaded after the engine: cars on the ground plane, a race round a track, the drivers who race it
  • modules/fight.jsa module, loaded after the engine: one-on-one fighting: fighters with frame data, guards, throws, specials, a meter; rounds; a CPU; training
  • modules/gen.jsa module, loaded after the engine: generated maps: rooms and corridors, BSP, caves, mazes and scatter, from a seed
  • modules/grid.jsa module, loaded after the engine: square and hex grids: paths, ranges, lines, fields of view, fog, groups, movers and turns
  • modules/mode7.jsa module, loaded after the engine: a perspective floor drawn a row at a time, a sky that turns with it, everything on it scaled by its distance
  • modules/physics.jsa module, loaded after the engine: 2D rigid bodies: circles, boxes, polygons, segments; fast balls that never pass through
  • modules/road.jsa module, loaded after the engine: the pseudo-3D road: segments with curves and hills, lanes, rumble strips, roadside scenery, tunnels
  • modules/rooms.jsa module, loaded after the engine: a world of rooms joined at their edges, the map of what was explored, gates and saves
  • modules/rpg.jsa module, loaded after the engine: items, inventories, equipment, shops, a party's stats and levels, status, damage, encounters
  • modules/story.jsa module, loaded after the engine: dialogue as data, flags and values, a quest log and emote balloons
  • modules/strategy.jsa module, loaded after the engine: real-time strategy and simulation: selection, orders, armies, production, resources, placement, fog, AI; a day clock, needs, overlays
  • modules/terrain.jsa module, loaded after the engine: destructible ground in the side plane: carved and added, walked on, drawn in chunks
  • API.mdthe API card: read it whole
  • API-INDEX.mdevery public name, one line each: search it
  • AI_GUIDE.mdthe guide: recipes, the look, heights, sessions
  • tools/check.mjsplays a game headless and reports errors, screenshots and its snapshot
  • tools/filmstrip.mjsrecords frames into one picture
  • tools/replay.mjsreplays a recorded play session exactly
  • docs/ASSETS.mdthe asset card: objects and materials as data (r.shape), the core library, writing one
  • tools/asset-find.mjssearches the core library and the store: node tools/asset-find.mjs "tavern table"
  • tools/asset-sheet.mjsdraws an object in every view and says what reads badly
  • tools/asset-set.mjscuts the few entries a game uses from the store's sets
  • tools/asset-lib.mjsshared by the asset tools
  • game/game.jsthe template game: copy it
  • game/index.htmlthe template game: play it
  • game/test.mjsits headless test: node game/test.mjs
  • src/assets/the asset store: 29 sets of objects and materials converted from CC0 libraries, and their catalogs (docs/ASSETS.md, "Make one")
